name: contentos-agent-lite
author: Gregory Shevchenko

network.trigger: research step only, and only if that provider's key is set

writes: <project>/content-agent/_work/.cache/ (research cache, only if a provider key is set)
<project>/CLAUDE.md and <project>/AGENTS.md (managed teaching block between markers, by `init`; re-runnable, preserves your other content)
secrets: read from local .env / environment only; none committed
install: git clone; optional: python venv + pip install requests
